replies.author: Roguelike-Engine103
replies.body: Three hard years of coding, art design and editing. Started with 16-bit Hack 1.0.3 and ported it to 64-bit modern compiler then wrapped it with SDL 3 for cross platform audio and graphics support, Firebase for authentication and backend support. Curated and hand edited all the tiles and artwork myself using Adobe tools.
